YORK Performance Package

$1,799.98$1,319.32

The YORK Performance Strength System brings together premium strength equipment in a small footprint, while delivering the versatility of a much larger gym. From the smooth feel of the North American Olympic Training Bar to the fast-adjusting utility bench, every component is designed for lifters who appreciate quality, efficiency, and the details that help you design the workout you're looking forward to.

What's Included

  • Your Complete Strength System Includes:
  • FTS Press Squat Stands: Adjustable bar height supports squats, bench presses, overhead presses, and full-body strength training.
  • FTS Flat-to-Incline Utility Bench: Quickly adjusts for flat, incline and seated while helping you find the right position for each lift.
  • North American Olympic Training Bar: A premium 44 lb/20 Kg training bar with smooth needle-bearing rotation for controlled Olympic lifts and versatile strength training.
  • Rubber Training Bumper Plates: Includes pairs of 10, 25, 35, and 45 lb plates for progressive training with added floor protection.
  • Olympic Spring Collars: Keep plates securely positioned on the bar throughout your workout.

Why The YORK Performance Package?

The flat-to-incline bench allows you to effortlessly adjust both the seat and backrest to create a customized lifting position that feels secure, comfortable, and optimized for every exercise in your routine.

Key Detail #1

Train Your Entire Body with One System: The adjustable Press Squat Stand lets you quickly change the bar height for bench presses, squats, overhead presses, rows, and more, making it easy to transition between upper and lower-body exercises while training seated or standing.

Key Detail #2

Premium in Every Detail: From the smooth rotation of the needle-bearing Olympic bar to the quick-adjust utility bench and easy-to-use Olympic Spring Collars, every interaction is designed to make training faster, smoother, and more enjoyable. Because serious lifters know it’s the little details that make you look forward to every workout.

Key Detail #3

Optimal Performance. Optimal Footprint. Everything you need for serious strength has been engineered to fit into you space and push your training without sacrificing versatility. It’s proof that a thoughtfully designed home gym can deliver professional-level training without taking over your home.

Unlock dozens of exercises

Train your upper and lower body, lying, sitting or standing. More exercise options mean greater variety, better results, and a complete strength-training experience you will not outgrow or get bored of.

Equipment

As your strength grows, your equipment should grow with you without taking over your home. The YORK Performance Strength System delivers the versatility of a complete strength gym in a compact footprint, making it ideal for apartments, spare bedrooms, garages, and dedicated workout spaces. Every component has been thoughtfully selected to maximize performance, minimize clutter, and create a premium training experience you’ll appreciate every time you lift. It’s a complete system for people who value quality, efficiency, and lifelong strength.
